summary: Iteration 6 — Frontend-only verification of the 2 fixes from iteration_5 + full regression. Both fixes VERIFIED PASSING. Fix HIGH (DSP share modal degrades gracefully): modal opens with share-dsp-url, share-dsp-copy, share-dsp-download and share-dsp-close ALWAYS present; when the QR generator rejects the URL, share-dsp-qr-warning is shown with 'Preset demasiado grande para QR. Copiá el link.' while URL/copy/download remain functional. Fix MEDIUM (Badge + GlassCard forward data-testid): shared-dsp-badge (count=1, text 'Solo lectura') and shared-dsp-output-0 (count=1) now resolve on /shared/dsp with a valid preset. All regression targets pass: Kiosk (root, panic toggle, exit → /), Settings replay-tour-btn, 17 routes render with 0 page errors and 0 app console errors.

integration_issues.issue: As expected per review request, navigator.clipboard.writeText fails in the sandbox headless browser (permission not granted). Modal DOES NOT break: toast 'No se pudo copiar' appears and modal stays functional (URL/download/close all still work). This is environmental, not a real regression.

critical_code_review_comments: src/components/soundmap/share-dsp-modal.tsx L40-58: encoded preset is recomputed via useMemo on every outputs/dspModel change AND ts:Date.now() is captured inside the memo — meaning ts stays stable across re-opens of the same modal but resets only when outputs/model actually change. This is fine but subtly counter-intuitive (ts is not 'creation time' but 'first memoization time'). Non-blocking.

src/components/soundmap/share-dsp-modal.tsx L67: QR errorCorrectionLevel is 'L' with width 320. For 5-output demo preset the URL is ~5KB which exceeds even L capacity. The graceful degradation now works, but consider a second attempt with a smaller QR (or splitting the payload) — currently users with >3 outputs will never get a QR. Non-blocking (behavior is documented via qr-warning).
src/pages/shared-dsp/index.tsx L21-35 decodePreset: still no length caps on preset.outputs / preset.outputs[i].eq — a malicious link can DOS the render. Same comment as iteration_5, still applies.

src/components/soundmap/ui.tsx L22/L258/L429: forwarding data-testid via rest["data-testid"] works but it's a bit boilerplaty. Could destructure explicitly as `{ 'data-testid': testId, ...rest }` for readability. Non-blocking.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — both fixes verified, all regressions pass (Kiosk, Settings, 17-route render). Only environmental notice: clipboard API blocked in headless (expected).

seed_data_creation: Onboarding 'Cargar Recinto Demo' button (in onboarding modal, no testid) → seeds 'The Warehouse Club' room + PA + DSP so /dsp has 5 outputs for the share modal test. Also used hand-crafted 1-output DSP preset in URL hash for /shared/dsp test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 6. Preview: https://soundmap-preview.preview.emergentagent.com. Cloudflare rate limits still active — kept >=6.5s between page.goto calls, no 429s hit. Onboarding modal on first load intercepts pointer events over the Index page's load-demo-btn — must click the ONBOARDING 'Cargar Recinto Demo' button (in onboarding.tsx L123, no testid) via get_by_role('button', name='Cargar Recinto Demo').first.click(force=True) to seed. Both iteration_5 bugs are fully fixed. Mobile viewport 420x900 works fine. Clipboard API is blocked in headless — the toast 'No se pudo copiar' is EXPECTED and does not break the modal.
